sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The two pie charts below show the online shopping sales for retail sectors in Canada in 2005 and 2010. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people think that to reduce traffic and pollution, the government should increase tax on petrol (gasoline). Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
